authority: User requested concretizing technical windows/thresholds and closing V4-02; engineering values selected by agent, not retrospective user sign-off
scope: Codex technical reference feasibility only; no implementation or candidate result

hosts.client_version: capture actual value per future sample

roles.functional_decisions_and_future_authoriz: current user in session; no organizational identity inferred

W0.name: study preparation
W0.costs: record separately, never discard setup/failure costs

W1.name: whole task in host
W1.start: first message of a fresh case chat, including bootstrap and instruction reads
W1.end: closed turn presenting technical result, actual checks and pending integration/acceptance

W2.name: technical journey within W1
W2.end: required final state/evidence and configured diagnostic conservation

W3.name: post-case study analysis
include: extract numeric counters after turn completion

comparison_controls.initial_case: equivalent code, contract, controls, logical roles and tools; restore frozen snapshot
comparison_controls.raw_capture: stdout/stderr/exit/duration saved before parse; API fallback retains distinct boundary
comparison_controls.normalization: declared UUID/date/path mapping in semantic copies only; originals and measured bytes unchanged
comparison_controls.known_reference_renderer_failure: preserve as real failure; no unreported repair or substitution
comparison_controls.cache: same observable policy; record cached categories and filesystem warm state; no forced cache clearing

B_out.source: complete original CLI stdout/stderr plus actual attachment/file deliveries

N_admin.include: preparation/presentation/records/queries/diagnostics/mutations/failures/retries; three commands in one host tool count three
N_admin.internal_guards: reported and preserved, not removed to lower count

host_tokens.source: deduplicated response records matched to final completed turn counters
host_tokens.formula: input+output; cached and reasoning fields are subsets
host_tokens.eligibility: all W1 turns, comparable model/configuration, no unseparable study contamination

T_machine.source: monotonic full sequential technical journey, including CLI startup, tests, necessary IO and diagnostics
T_machine.claim: technical journey time, not full human development time

E3.missing_or_incomparable: not-measured or inconclusive; no total-token-savings claim

E4_M6.otherwise: discard or inconclusive, no performance-based incorporation

regression.smaller_reproducible_regressions: report and assess; no permitted regression allowance

aggregation.primary_aggregate: median of per-case medians, equal case weight, never pool hosts

budget.rule: reconcile and reserve complete block before future execution; no reset, expansion or sacrifice of mandatory coverage; no new human session reserved

candidate_loading.route: external reproducible Codex marketplace/project runtime; docs/DISTRIBUTION.md; recheck actual client surface then
candidate_loading.M4_host_proof: candidate instructions and candidate pinned runtime loaded, no duplicate project/plugin skills

claim_limits: No savings demonstrated before candidate comparison
Historical mixed windows not eligible savings baseline
No human-effort or tedium improvement claim
No invoice savings claim without invoice
No plugin implementation or installation authorization
